description: Implementation of TCP packet creation and manipulation functions for IPv6, including generating TCP RST packets within the quiche QUIC library.

classes.name: TCPv6Packet
classes.description: Structure representing an IPv6 TCP packet with IP and TCP headers.

classes.name: TCPv6PseudoHeader
classes.description: Structure representing the pseudo-header used for TCP checksum calculation in IPv6.

methods.name: CreateTcpResetPacket
methods.description: Creates a TCP RST packet based on an original IPv6 packet and executes a callback with the generated packet.
